role: Researchers on Howard Creek sediment transport
stance_basis: paraphrase recommending storm flow augmentation as a mitigation measure for construction sediment impacts on Howard Creek
summary: Langdon, et al. (1976) are cited as researchers who recommend storm flow augmentation after construction to help flush Howard Creek of sediment accumulations and reduce recovery time. Their recommendation is presented as a mitigation measure in the context of construction impacts on Howard Creek, suggesting conditional support contingent on implementation of this specific remediation technique.
complaint_summary: Langdon, et al. (1976) recommend the use of storm flow augmentation after construction to flush Howard Creek of sediment accumulations from construction activities and reduce the time required for stream recovery.
